title: Email
unassigned: No Microsoft 365 mailbox is assigned to your account. A super admin can assign one with the users:assign-mailbox command. This screen uses only your own mailbox.
blockedExplanation_one: 1 blocked or undeliverable email is hidden from this inbox (latest 100 messages checked).
blockedExplanation_other: {{count}} blocked or undeliverable emails are hidden from this inbox (latest 100 messages checked).
confirmMarkAllRead: Mark every email in the Inbox as read?
confirmMarkAllUnread: Mark every email in the Inbox as unread?
signatureHelp: This text is added at the end of every message you send.
headerHelp: This image is placed at the top of every message you send.
headerSizeHelp: Width of the image in the message, from 20 to 100. The height follows the picture.
footerColorsHelp: Add up to 8 colored boxes. They appear under the signature on every message you send. Select a box to remove it.
subject: Subject
templateGeneralBody:
Hello,

I’m reaching out regarding your project. Please let me know if you have any questions or need additional information.

Thank you.
templateFollowUpBody:
Hello,

I wanted to follow up on my previous message. Please let me know when you have an update.

Thank you.
templateProjectUpdateBody:
Hello,

Here is the latest update for the project:

Please let me know if you have any questions or changes.

Thank you.
templateAvailabilityBody:
Hello,

Could you please confirm current availability and expected lead time?

Thank you.
templateThankYouBody:
Hello,

Thank you for your time and assistance. We appreciate your help and will follow up if anything else is needed.

Best regards.
attachmentUnavailable: This file could not be opened.
attachmentMissing: This message has an attachment. Refresh the mailbox, then open the message again.
messageRequired: Write at least 8 characters before sending.
sentNotice: Microsoft 365 accepted the message for sending.
turnOnDeviceNotifications: Turn on email notifications for this device, including when the website is closed
turnOffDeviceNotifications: Turn off notifications for this device
notificationIosHelp: On iPhone, tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, then open Gateway from the Home Screen and tap this button again.
notificationUnsupported: This browser does not support system notifications.
notificationBlocked: Notifications are blocked. Allow them for this site in your browser or device settings, then try again.
notificationEnabled: Notifications are on for this device. New email can appear even when the website is closed. A test notification was just sent.
notificationTestFailed: Notifications are on, but the test failed: {{reason}}
notificationDisabled: Notifications are off for this device.
notificationChangeFailed: Could not change notification settings. Please try again.
received: Microsoft 365 receives mail in this mailbox. This page reads it when you open the folder or click Refresh. It does not collect new mail while the page is closed.
select: Select a message to read it as plain text.
sectionCallToActionDetail: Add the action you want the recipient to take.
stationeryHelp: These sections are written into the message, the same way Outlook places a signature. Use Add logo to place the company logo in the message. It is shown from the website and is not attached as a file.
logoHelp: Add logo places the company logo in this section. Recipients see it in the message. It is not attached as a file.
layoutHelp: Choose a blank message or a layout. The header, signature, and footer sit in the message, where you can edit them before sending.
layoutBlankDetail: A clear page with your signature at the bottom.
layoutNoteDetail: A short note with your signature.
layoutAnnouncementDetail: A centered title for a notice.
layoutProjectDetail: A labeled update with your letterhead.
layoutFollowUpDetail: A short follow-up under your header.
